privacy.title: Personal data protection
privacy.intro: Clinique Metidja Al Djazair processes your personal data in accordance with Law No. 18-07 of 10 June 2018 on the protection of natural persons in the processing of personal data.

sections.title: Data collected
sections.text: Identity, contact details, appointment information and — with your explicit consent — health data (prescriptions, lab results).

sections.title: Purposes
sections.text: Managing appointments, medical follow-up, sending SMS/WhatsApp confirmations and answering your requests. No data is sold or used for advertising.

sections.title: Security
sections.text: Hashed passwords (bcrypt), secure sessions, record access restricted to authorised staff, encrypted connections (HTTPS).

sections.title: Retention
sections.text: Data is kept for as long as needed for medical follow-up and legal obligations.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.text: You have the right to information, access, rectification and objection. To exercise them, contact the clinic reception or write to us via the Contact page. You may also contact the national personal data protection authority (ANPDP).
